Office Seeking printed 'Utah County Sheriff'; party Republican; the cover's own address is a Provo suite. THE AMENDMENT QUESTION IS WHOLLY UNTICKED - neither Yes nor No - an honest BLANK, not 'No' (ADDENDUM A4). Single report, no bundle. FOUR pages: p1 cover / p2 SUMMARY PAGE / p3 SCHEDULE A / p4 SCHEDULE B, each classified from its own printed heading; no checklist decoy. FOLIATION EXCLUDES THE COVER here (summary 'Page 1 of 3', Schedule A '2 of 3', Schedule B '3 of 3') - the opposite convention from the Durfey filing in this same chunk and cycle, which counts the cover; page ordinals locate nothing. THE FILER SEGREGATES IN-KIND WITH A WRITTEN BANNER on both schedules - a clean instance of the ADDENDUM E3 banner-line trap, and the reason both transcribed Schedule A rows sit on printed rows 1 and 5. Contributions reconcile EXACTLY; expenditures carry a +0.34 delta that no cell can absorb, retained verbatim.
